title: Workspace
description: An isolated execution workspace: a base path plus the worktree checkout a Work Unit runs in. Mirrors WorkspaceRef in src/protocol.ts on the snake_case wire form.

worktree_path.description: Isolated worktree checkout the Work Unit executes in.

runtime.description: Runtime that created this workspace, for traceability only.

isolation.description: Isolation mechanism in use, e.g. git_worktree. Recorded for auditability; a git worktree is developer isolation, not a security boundary.
